comment: Git blob SHAs of the karakeep files the vendored stubs and the install
instructions were written against. A blob SHA is a hash of file content, so
these stay valid across commits that do not touch these files, and break the
check-upstream-drift.sh re-fetches each path and compares. A mismatch does
not mean the plugin is broken -- it means nobody has checked since the file
moved, and `npm run typecheck` is now checking against a stale contract.

packages/shared-server/src/plugins.ts.why: install step 3 adds an import to loadAllPlugins(); order decides which Search plugin wins
